FCF conversion averaged 93.3% of net income over 10 years ($4.32B Owner FCF on $4.27B net income in 2025). Peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounded from $0.34 in 2016 to $0.48 in 2018, $0.50 in 2020, $0.79 in 2023, and $1.67 in 2025. Strong balance sheet with $11.1B cash vs $14.6B debt (net debt $3.4B pre-closing of CommScope CCS, pro forma net leverage ~1.8x EBITDA) and 15.9x interest coverage. Radical decentralized operating model with <100 HQ personnel presiding over >130 autonomous units.
